_about: Tribal allotment territories for Joshua 13-21. Polygons are APPROXIMATE bounding shapes only — they do NOT trace the boundary descriptions in the biblical text. Replace with sourced GeoJSON (openbible.info, Macmillan/Carta digitization, or hand-traced from the text) before treating as final. Each feature has properties.tribe (slug, matches chapter JSON tribes[] field), properties.name (display name), and properties.approximate (true means placeholder).

properties.name: Judah
properties.note: Placeholder bounds: hill country south of Jerusalem to the Negev, Mediterranean coast to Dead Sea. The biblical boundary description in Joshua 15 is far more detailed than this rectangle.
